title: SBOM: generating, storing and querying it (CycloneDX and SPDX)

videos.script: Imagine a morning. An advisory lands for a library you have never heard of. Your manager asks one question. Are we affected? {{morning}} If nobody wrote down what is inside each image, the answer takes days. Somebody has to pull every image and look inside it. {{days}} A software bill of materials is that list, written on the day of the build. With it, the answer is one query. {{query}} In this lesson you make one for linkbox with syft, in the two standard formats, and read them side by side. {{formats}} You ask it questions with jq. And it shows you a package in your image that nobody on the team ever chose. {{packaging}} Then you scan the list without the image, and get a surprising zero. That zero teaches the most important thing about an SBOM. {{zero}} By the end, your pipeline writes one for every image it pushes, and keeps it beside the run. {{pipeline}}
